reading: Recent news stories raise questions about how powerful people in television treat others.
These stories follow changes that began years ago.
Reporters started looking into these stories years ago.
Their work can take a long time.
Kirsty Wark says more women speak up because they see other women doing this.
Freeman says women now feel that people will listen to them.
A workers' group says some television workers are still afraid to report problems.
Lucy Beaumont says some well-known people stay quiet because they fear losing work.
A meeting with television leaders is planned for next week to discuss keeping people safe.
People who run television companies also need to help stop people from hurting others.

vocabulary.definition: People who find information and write or tell news stories.
Tell other people about a problem instead of staying quiet.
Pay attention to what someone says.
Worried that something bad may happen.
No longer having a job or paid work.
Not in danger of being hurt.

entries.ja: 情報を集め、ニュースを文章や言葉で伝える人たち。
entries.ko: 정보를 찾아 뉴스를 글로 쓰거나 말로 전하는 사람들.
entries.zh-Hans: 搜集信息并撰写或讲述新闻报道的人。
entries.es: Personas que buscan información y escriben o cuentan noticias.
entries.pt-BR: Pessoas que buscam informações e escrevem ou relatam notícias.
entries.fr: Personnes qui recherchent des informations et présentent les nouvelles par écrit ou oralement.
entries.de: Menschen, die Informationen sammeln und Nachrichten schreiben oder darüber berichten.

entries.ja: 黙っていないで、問題についてほかの人に伝えること。
entries.ko: 침묵하지 않고 다른 사람들에게 문제에 대해 말하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 把问题告诉别人，而不是保持沉默。
entries.es: Hablar con otras personas sobre un problema en vez de quedarse en silencio.
entries.pt-BR: Falar com outras pessoas sobre um problema em vez de ficar em silêncio.
entries.fr: Parler d’un problème aux autres au lieu de garder le silence.
entries.de: Anderen von einem Problem erzählen, anstatt zu schweigen.

entries.ja: 誰かが言うことに注意を向けて聞くこと。
entries.ko: 누군가가 하는 말에 주의를 기울이는 것.
entries.es: Prestar atención a lo que alguien dice.
entries.pt-BR: Prestar atenção ao que alguém diz.
entries.fr: Prêter attention à ce que quelqu’un dit.
entries.de: Auf das achten, was jemand sagt.

entries.ja: 何か悪いことが起こるかもしれないと心配していること。
entries.ko: 나쁜 일이 일어날까 봐 걱정하는 상태.
entries.zh-Hans: 担心可能会发生不好的事情。
entries.es: Sentir preocupación porque puede pasar algo malo.
entries.pt-BR: Estar preocupado com a possibilidade de algo ruim acontecer.
entries.fr: S’inquiéter à l’idée que quelque chose de mauvais puisse arriver.
entries.de: Besorgt, dass etwas Schlimmes passieren könnte.

entries.ja: 職や報酬を得られる仕事がなくなること。
entries.ko: 직장이나 보수를 받는 일이 더 이상 없는 상태가 되는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 不再有职位或有报酬的工作。
entries.es: Dejar de tener un empleo o trabajo remunerado.
entries.pt-BR: Deixar de ter um emprego ou trabalho remunerado.
entries.fr: Ne plus avoir d’emploi ou de travail rémunéré.
entries.de: Keine Arbeitsstelle oder bezahlte Arbeit mehr haben.

entries.ja: 傷つけられる危険がないこと。
entries.es: No estar en peligro de sufrir daño.
entries.pt-BR: Não correr o risco de sofrer algum dano.
entries.fr: Ne pas être exposé à un danger pouvant causer du mal.
entries.de: Nicht in Gefahr, Schaden zu erleiden.

review.method: separate ChatGPT plan translation and independent editing sessions
